rules.text: Good intellect when young but retention fades later

source.quote: retention power diminishes in a later age

rules.say: With your mental plane (4-9-2) missing, your intellect is good when young, but memory and retention can fade later in life.

rules.text: Loneliness; less emotional towards self and others

source.quote: Loneliness, Less Emotional towards oneself and Others

rules.say: With your emotional plane (3-5-7) missing, you may feel lonely and be less emotional towards yourself and others.

rules.text: Loss, lack of success, lack of luxury, masterplan failure

source.quote: Loss, Lack of Success, Lack of Luxury, Masterplan Failure

rules.say: With your physical plane (8-1-6) missing, you may face losses, less success and luxury, and the failure of big plans.

rules.text: Plane of confusion; no clear goal, no planning

source.quote: Plane of Confusion. No Clear Goal, No Planning

rules.say: With your vision plane (4-3-8) missing, you may feel confused, without a clear goal or planning.

rules.text: No desire to succeed; lots of thinking but indecisive

source.quote: Lack of Desire to Be Successful, Lots of thinking but indecisiveness

rules.say: With your will plane (9-5-1) missing, you may lack the desire to succeed, and think a lot but struggle to decide.

rules.text: Apathy, no risk-taking, no energy to fight back, laziness

source.quote: Apathy, No Risk-Taking Capacity, No energy to Fight Back, Laziness

rules.say: With your action plane (2-7-6) missing, you may feel apathy and laziness, avoid risks and lack the energy to fight back.

rules.text: Frustration, obstacles everywhere, hustle, consistent failure

source.quote: Frustration, Obstacles everywhere, Hustle, Consistent Failure

rules.say: With your silver plane (2-5-8) missing, you may face frustration, obstacles everywhere, constant hustle and repeated failure.

rules.text: Suspicious, trust issues, won't collaborate easily

source.quote: Suspicious, has Trust issues, and Will not Collaborate with anyone Easily.

rules.say: With your golden plane (4-5-6) missing, you may be suspicious, have trust issues and find it hard to work with others.
